**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replay the StrictMode effect lifecycle in the harness**

This `useEffect` stub runs setup only once, whereas the application mounts under `React.StrictMode` in `frontend/src/main.tsx`, which replays effects as setup → cleanup → setup during development. If `lawSaveMountedRef.current = true` is removed or broken in the real effect setup, this harness still starts from `useRef(true)` and every new navigation/unmount assertion passes, but the StrictMode-mounted app remains at `false` after the simulated cleanup and suppresses navigation after a successful save. Replay cleanup and setup here, or mount the actual hook, so the setup half of the ref lifecycle cannot regress undetected.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

6b6dea1cb5240ae22f2e03ebe8191b84207705e6에서 시험 하네스만 수정했습니다. 실제 effect를 setup → cleanup → setup으로 재실행하고 마지막 cleanup을 unmount에 사용합니다. 원본 시험12통과/0실패/1skip; 실제 setup의 mounted=true 대입을 메모리에서 제거하면7통과/5실패/1skip으로 검출합니다. 앱 파일 변경 없음. 최신 HEAD의 Codex 재검토를 별도로 요청합니다.
